subject: MAP + Eval Plan: proposed tactical reset and risk acceptance
content:
From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@acme.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & eval windows — procurement delay update

Hi Jasmine,

Quick update from our side: procurement has pushed the PO approval window out by two business weeks due to a vendor consolidation review. The technical eval will still proceed, but the official commitment (PO + legal sign-off) is unlikely before 09/15. That creates a close-date slip from the current 09/01 target.

Emily
Emily Wu
Sr. PM, Platform Integrations
Acme Corp

[Attachment: procurement_note.pdf]

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & eval windows — tactical reset proposal

Thanks for the heads up, Emily — and understood on procurement. I captured the impact in the attached MAP_v2 and highlighted the critical eval gates we need to keep on track so the product team can start integrating the SDK immediately.

Proposed tactical reset (summary):
- Move legal/PO target to 2025-09-15 (accept slip)
- Keep technical eval: SE-assisted test integration day 1 => 2025-08-29
- Staggered cutover: pilot (non-prod) 2025-09-02, prod toggle 2025-09-21
- Redwood to provide a temporary sandbox token and priority SE hours during procurement pause

Risks and mitigations (high level):
- Risk: integration delays if eval uncovers performance regressions.
  Mitigation: expedited tukey-style triage (Marcus) + two extra SE days during 8/29–9/05.
- Risk: procurement holds create SLA exceptions.
  Mitigation: offer a one-month credit and extend pilot to preserve good faith.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (updated timeline), eval_plan_comments.pdf (internal notes).

Can you confirm the new target window from procurement? If 9/15 is firm, I’ll route a short exec note and an ask for temporary credit approval to my manager.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Wu <emily.wu@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & eval windows — operational risk log

Looping in a short risk log snapshot so we have a single source for the next 48 hours. I added owners and acceptance thresholds. Please review and adjust owners as needed.

Risk log (snapshot):
1) Procurement slip (severity: high) — Owner: Jasmine
   - Trigger: PO not returned by 2025-09-01
   - Acceptance: team agrees to pilot-only access until PO cleared
   - Action: Jasmine to request one-month credit; Laura to approve pilot retention policy
2) Eval regression (severity: medium) — Owner: Marcus
   - Trigger: 95th percentile latency > 600ms for production-like load
   - Acceptance: degrade to smaller model variant + Redwood routing for lower cost
   - Action: Marcus to run targeted stress tests and submit findings by 2025-09-03
3) Legal redline (severity: medium) — Owner: Jasmine / Aditya
   - Trigger: redlines require >3 negotiating passes
   - Acceptance: provide conditional PO signature with escrow clause
   - Action: Jasmine to escalate to Aditya if negotiation extends past 9/10

Attachment: risk_log_snapshot.csv

I’ll also prepare a short one-pager on the credit policy so we can move quickly if requested.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 27 Aug 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & eval windows — SE plan and gating criteria

I validated the gating criteria with our infra team. Quick notes:
- SE-assisted integration day (8/29) should cover SDK install, KV cache smoke test, and 2 representative queries. Plan for 3 hours.
- If latency shows up at scale, we have two fallback paths: 1) temporary quantized model (lower cost/latency), 2) selective routing to a regional pool. Both require a config toggle I can prepare today.
- I’ll post a short checklist to the Drive link and tag Emily.

Attachment: SE_checklist.md (posted to Drive)

Marcus Lin
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 27 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
